Title: Integrating Metabolic Modeling and Targeted Supplementation for the Rapid Detection of Clostridium tyrobutyricum in Dairy Products
Summary: Integrates genome-scale metabolic modeling and flux balance analysis with targeted nutrient supplementation to accelerate culture-based detection of Clostridium tyrobutyricum.

Title: PMPIHGLL: predicting metabolite–protein interactions using dual hypergraph convolutional networks and large language models
Summary: Presents PMPIHGLL, a deep-learning model that uses chemical and protein language-model embeddings with dual hypergraph convolutional networks to predict metabolite–protein interactions.

Title: Programming 2,3-butanediol biosynthesis in Saccharomyces cerevisiae with AI-optimized dual-optogenetic switches
Summary: Engineers Saccharomyces cerevisiae for 2,3-butanediol biosynthesis using AI-optimized dual-optogenetic switches to balance growth and product synthesis.

Title: Metabolic reprogramming of the acetogen Clostridium sp. AWRP via adaptive laboratory evolution for improved formate-based growth
Summary: Uses adaptive laboratory evolution of the acetogen Clostridium sp. AWRP to improve formate-based growth, then maps genomic and transcriptomic rewiring in the adapted strain F30T.

Title: H2 + CO2-based co-cultivation of D-lactate-producing Acetobacterium woodii and chain-elongating Clostridium drakei
Summary: Co-cultivates D-lactate-producing Acetobacterium woodii with chain-elongating Clostridium drakei on H2 + CO2 to couple autotrophic carbon fixation with chain elongation.

Title: Engineering the Stability of Sucrose Synthase to Enable Efficient Coupled Production of UDP-Glucuronic Acid
Summary: Engineers sucrose synthase thermostability with structure-guided design to stabilize UDP-glucose supply for coupled biocatalytic production of UDP-glucuronic acid.

Title: Research progress on metabolic engineering for efficient squalene synthesis in yeast cell factories
Summary: Reviews metabolic engineering strategies for efficient squalene synthesis in yeast cell factories, from native MVA-pathway reinforcement to designed pathway integration.

Title: Recent advances and challenges for engineered microbial production of L-histidine and its functional derivatives
Summary: Reviews recent advances and remaining challenges in engineered microbial production of L-histidine and its functional derivatives.

Title: Advances in the Biosynthesis of Noncanonical Amino Acids for Genetic Code Expansion
Summary: Reviews metabolic engineering and pathway-design strategies for autonomous microbial biosynthesis of noncanonical amino acids to support genetic code expansion.

Title: Design and construction of microbial carbon fixation pathways empowered by synthetic biology
Summary: Reviews natural and synthetic microbial carbon-fixation pathways and energy-supply strategies, including modification of natural routes and design of synthetic pathways.
